field.label: Validate DNSSEC
field.help: Perform DNSSEC validation on responses and return SERVFAIL for records that fail validation. Upstream resolvers must return DNSSEC records.

field.label: Max chain depth
field.help: Maximum delegation chain depth followed during validation.

field.label: Trust cache expiration (hours)
field.help: How long validated DNSKEY/DS records are cached.

field.label: Max upstream queries
field.help: Maximum number of upstream queries used to validate a single response.

field.label: Max NSEC3 iterations
field.help: Maximum NSEC3 hash iterations accepted (protects against CPU exhaustion).

field.label: Clock skew tolerance (seconds)
field.help: Tolerance applied to RRSIG inception/expiration times to allow for clock differences.

field.label: Custom trust anchors
field.help: Custom DNSKEY/DS records (DNS record format) that replace the built-in IANA root trust anchors. Leave empty to use the defaults; only override for private zones or lab testing.

field.label: Enable
field.help: Drop answers from the general upstreams that contain private, loopback, link-local or unspecified IPs (e.g. 127.0.0.1, 192.168.x.x), which are a hallmark of DNS rebinding attacks. Use Allowed domains for split-horizon names that legitimately resolve to private addresses.

field.label: Allowed domains
field.help: Domains exempt from rebinding protection (they may legitimately resolve to private addresses). Type a domain and press Enter to add it.

field.label: Enable
field.help: Limit the number of queries accepted per client per second. Intended for misbehaving clients and low-volume amplification abuse, not as a DDoS defense (use the firewall for that). Queries over the limit are dropped silently.

field.label: Queries per second
field.help: Sustained queries per second allowed per client. 0 disables rate limiting.

field.label: Burst
field.help: Token bucket capacity: the maximum number of queries a previously idle client may fire at once before being throttled to the sustained rate. Must be at least the rate; 0 falls back to rate × 2.

field.label: IPv4 prefix length
field.help: Clients are grouped into IPv4 subnets of this prefix length for rate-limit accounting (32 = per address).

field.label: IPv6 prefix length
field.help: Clients are grouped into IPv6 subnets of this prefix length for rate-limit accounting.

field.label: Exempt clients
field.help: Client IPs or CIDR ranges exempt from rate limiting. Type a value and press Enter to add it.

field.label: FQDN only
field.help: Refuse queries for non-fully-qualified names (names without a dot), reducing noise from local lookups.

field.label: Extended DNS Errors
field.help: Attach Extended DNS Error (EDE, RFC 8914) codes to responses, giving clients a machine-readable reason when a query is blocked or fails.

field.label: Special-use domains
field.help: Handle special-use domain names (RFC 6761) such as .invalid and .test locally instead of forwarding them upstream.

field.label: Block private-use TLDs
field.help: Block the recommended private-use top-level domains listed in RFC 6762 Appendix G (e.g. .corp, .home, .lan, .internal) so they are not leaked to upstream resolvers.
